read_sparse_matrix_from_file: read a 3-column tab-separated file into a scipy sparse CSR matrix with row and column vocabularies
read_sparse_matrix_with_cache: read a sparse matrix file and cache the result as a pickle file for faster subsequent reads
read_sparse_matrix_same_vocab: read a sparse matrix file where rows and columns share the same vocabulary mapping
read_sparse_matrix_gzip: read a gzip compressed 3-column sparse matrix file and return a scipy sparse matrix with vocabularies
parse_three_column_line: parse a tab-separated line with two or three columns into target, context, and weight values
